floodMap.title: Flood Map
floodMap.subtitle: Monitor flood conditions and warnings in real-time

instructions.title: User Guide
instructions.clickZone: Click on colored areas to view flood details
instructions.clickStation: Click on 📍 icon to view station information
instructions.clickWarning: Click on ⚠️ icon to view warning details
instructions.toggleButton: Use toggle button to show/hide flood zones layer

avoid.title: Things to Avoid
avoid.tip1: Do not walk through fast-flowing or deep water
avoid.tip2: Stay away from power poles and downed power lines in water
avoid.tip3: Do not attempt to drive through flooded areas
avoid.tip4: Do not drink untreated water from flooded areas

should.title: What to Do
should.tip2: Prepare emergency kits and essential supplies
should.tip3: Move to higher ground when evacuation is ordered

citizenReport.title: Report Flooding
